content: In Hebrews, faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what?
explanation: Faith trusts God's promises. “Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.” (Hebrews 11:1, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, without what is it impossible to please God?
explanation: We must believe He exists. “And without faith it is impossible to please God” (Hebrews 11:6, BSB)

content: In Hebrews' list of faith heroes, who built an ark to save his family?
explanation: He was warned of things not yet seen. “By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family.” (Hebrews 11:7, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, who obeyed God and went without knowing where he was going?
explanation: He trusted God's call. “obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.” (Hebrews 11:8, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, who by faith offered God a better sacrifice than Cain?
explanation: He was commended as righteous. “By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did.” (Hebrews 11:4, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, by faith whose walls fell after seven days of marching?
explanation: Israel trusted God's plan. “By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.” (Hebrews 11:30, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, who by faith was taken up so that he did not see death?
explanation: He pleased God. “By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death” (Hebrews 11:5, BSB)

content: After the heroes of faith, Hebrews says to fix our eyes on whom?
explanation: He is the author and perfecter of our faith. “Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith” (Hebrews 12:2, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and when?
explanation: He never changes. “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.” (Hebrews 13:8, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, the word of God is sharper than any what?
explanation: It judges the heart. “Sharper than any double-edged sword” (Hebrews 4:12, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, God says, “Never will I leave you, never will I…”
explanation: So be content. “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.” (Hebrews 13:5, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, in these last days, through whom has God spoken to us?
explanation: Before, He spoke through prophets. “But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son” (Hebrews 1:2, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, our high priest was tempted in every way, yet was what?
explanation: He can sympathize with us. “but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.” (Hebrews 4:15, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, how should we approach the throne of grace?
explanation: We will find grace and mercy. “Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence” (Hebrews 4:16, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, how is the word of God described?
explanation: It reaches the heart. “For the word of God is living and active.” (Hebrews 4:12, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, who by faith conceived a child though beyond the proper age?
explanation: She considered God faithful. “By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child” (Hebrews 11:11, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, how long did Moses' parents hide him by faith?
explanation: They did not fear the king's edict. “By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth” (Hebrews 11:23, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, what did grown-up Moses refuse to be called?
explanation: He chose God's people. “By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.” (Hebrews 11:24, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, since we are surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, how should we run?
explanation: Throw off every hindrance. “and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.” (Hebrews 12:1, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, what should believers not neglect?
explanation: Encourage one another. “Let us not neglect meeting together” (Hebrews 10:25, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, by showing hospitality, some have entertained whom without knowing?
explanation: Welcome strangers. “for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.” (Hebrews 13:2, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, which king of Salem and priest of God blessed Abraham?
explanation: He is a picture of Christ. “This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High.” (Hebrews 7:1, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, the Son is the radiance of God's what?
explanation: He upholds all things. “The Son is the radiance of God’s glory” (Hebrews 1:3, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, who did not perish because she welcomed the spies in peace?
explanation: Her faith saved her. “By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish” (Hebrews 11:31, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, when Abraham was tested, whom did he offer on the altar?
explanation: His one and only son. “By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar.” (Hebrews 11:17, BSB)

content: In Hebrews, by faith we understand the universe was formed by what?
explanation: Seen things came from the unseen. “By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command” (Hebrews 11:3, BSB)
